info.title: Job Seeker API
info.description: Dopasowuje oferty pracy z serwisów (na razie JustJoin.it) do CV kandydata.

get.description: Offers ranked by fit. ``mode=basic`` uses rules only; ``mode=ai`` also asks the configured model.

parameters.name: status

schema.description: Only saved / only hidden offers (default: all but hidden)
schema.title: Status

parameters.description: Only saved / only hidden offers (default: all but hidden)

parameters.name: activity

schema.description: Only offers never opened on the job board / only offers marked as applied
schema.title: Activity

parameters.description: Only offers never opened on the job board / only offers marked as applied

get.description: Offer from the local database (``source:external_id``), with its description fetched on demand.

put.description: Mark an offer as saved or hidden (hidden offers are left out of /matches); null clears the mark.
Record that the user opened the offer on the job board and/or applied to it; omitted fields stay as they are.

post.description: AI-assess one offer, e.g. one outside the top N rated in /matches?mode=ai.

get.description: Current profile; rebuilt automatically when the CV file changed.

post.description: Upload a new CV (PDF). It becomes the newest file in the CV folder and the profile is rebuilt.

put.description: Replace manual profile corrections (kept across CV changes) and return the resulting profile.

schema.title: Response List Categories Sources  Source  Categories Get

post.description: Start downloading offers in the background; poll GET /sync/status for progress.

delete.description: Stop the running sync; offers downloaded so far are kept.

get.description: The default search and every [searches.<name>] preset from config.toml, with offer counts.
Effective search preferences: config.toml [search], optionally with a named preset applied.
